query:
-- Backfill Agent A rows: counterpartyAddress = Agent B's senderAddress
UPDATE htlc_swaps a
JOIN htlc_swaps b ON b.rfqId = a.rfqId AND b.htlcId LIKE 'htlc_b_%'
SET a.counterpartyAddress = b.senderAddress
WHERE a.htlcId LIKE 'htlc_a_%'
  AND (a.counterpartyAddress IS NULL OR a.counterpartyAddress = '');

-- Backfill Agent B rows: counterpartyAddress = Agent A's senderAddress
UPDATE htlc_swaps b
JOIN htlc_swaps a ON a.rfqId = b.rfqId AND a.htlcId LIKE 'htlc_a_%'
SET b.counterpartyAddress = a.senderAddress
WHERE b.htlcId LIKE 'htlc_b_%'
  AND (b.counterpartyAddress IS NULL OR b.counterpartyAddress = '');

-- Also backfill using recipientAddress as fallback for rows where the peer row doesn't exist
UPDATE htlc_swaps
SET counterpartyAddress = recipientAddress
WHERE (counterpartyAddress IS NULL OR counterpartyAddress = '')
  AND recipientAddress IS NOT NULL
  AND recipientAddress != senderAddress;
